title: fix(news): list every new official model in the weekly model post
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Updated the weekly Discord model-post prompt to list every new official model (`community` not `true`) under 🆕 New and every price increase under ⬆️. To stay within Discord’s 1,900-character limit, it shortens price-cut, paid-only and capability lists instead. An unsent preview for the same week listed 15 of 15 new official models, up from 10 of 15, while retaining all price increases; its length changed from 1,682 to 1,705 characters.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden newsroom, Polli, the main character, wears a tiny editor’s visor and checks a lime green (#ecf874) model-post sheet beside a single glowing CRT monitor and blooming code-plants; she is a small cute pixel art bee with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, and a quiet newsroom feel.
